name: RC-B10-0177/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks Azerbaijan to free 23 detained Armenians, including former Nagorno-Karabakh officials, and says their trials are unfair. It wants the European Union to watch those trials, consider sanctions on named Azerbaijani officials, and put conditions on its energy deal with Azerbaijan. It also asks the International Criminal Court to investigate the treatment of Armenians from Nagorno-Karabakh.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** The 23 Armenian detainees, Azerbaijani officials, and the European Union's energy deal with Azerbaijan.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission, member states and both governments.
